notes.title: 2 Years Anniversary
notes.notes:
The 23th October we celebrate the 2nd year anniversary of Bocce Revolution!

We're very grateful to all the players that enjoyed our game and for the positive feedback we got.

We have set a new selling price, now you can buy Bocce Revolution for just $ 9,99!

notes.notes:
Let's celebrate the 1st year anniversary of Bocce Revolution! :)
